rig: three-rocks, COM8, three identical Quad coils (Brian-built)
recorded: 2026-09-17 by tempo from Brian's numbers (voice) + coil_build_specs_3in.md; firmware teensy_three_rocks.ino; BOARD_PINOUT_FULL_2026-09-15.md

coil.name: Quad (n=4 star-quad twisted bundle), x3 identical
coil.twist_note: one full twist per 11 in = one bundle rotation per coil turn (circumference pi*3.5 = 11.0 in): every strand sweeps every geometric position once per turn
coil.runner: straight axial wire under all the windings, between pipe and copper; sensed at its south end (A-pin), north end -> 100R -> GND bus
coil.build_variance_note: Brian stretched and measured by hand; 2-3 in lead-line difference at most between the three; 'the coils don't care'

drive.waveform: square 0..3.3 V (GPIO), fundamental amplitude (4/pi)*1.65 V = 2.101 V
drive.strands_on_pin: UNKNOWN (Brian to confirm): 1 strand | 4 in parallel | 4 in series. Sheet carries all three.
drive.path: pin -> 220R -> winding north; winding south -> GND bus

sense.lockin: I=mean(s*cos), Q=mean(s*sin), mag=sqrt(I^2+Q^2) -> mag = A/2 counts for a sine of amplitude A counts; phase=atan2(Q,I): in-phase-with-drive reads 90 deg by construction
sense.a_pin_bias: 10K to 3.3V + 10K to GND at the sense node (mid-rail)

geometry_today.formation: triangle (2026-09-17 morning), connected, no wires pulled
geometry_today.note: Brian to supply. 2026-09-16 spread config: ~2.5 in edge gap -> center-to-center ~6 in -> r = cc/OD = 1.71

shared_ground_r_ohm.note: breadboard rails + jumper contacts. The ONE EM parameter that can carry a flat, in-phase, common-mode reading. Not yet measured.
